objects.name: Analytic 2283
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a Windows process making Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol connections to device subnets from a process not in the authorized ICS applications list, structurally valid traffic from an unauthorized source. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: WinEventLog:Sysmon
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: EventCode=3 to device subnet from process not in authorized Industrial Control Systems (ICS) applications

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: The complete, maintained inventory of every legitimate source-to-destination communication pair in the ICS environment.
